verdict.rationale: 1Password documents its own export feature for moving your data to a different app, and it stores one-time passwords. However, the evidence never says the export includes TOTP secrets or names an open, readable format. A community report adds that export only worked from the desktop apps, which forced a Linux user to run a Windows VM just to leave. missing for 10: confirmation that TOTP secrets/seeds are included in exports, a documented open/readable export format (e.g. CSV/JSON with otpauth URIs), export availability on every platform, independent hands-on corroboration of a clean migration out.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: You can export your information from the 1Password apps if you want to move it to a different app.
Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
Couldn't export passwords on Linux because only the desktop apps support export, and it wouldn't run under Wine. Had to install a Windows VM just to do the export.
